findings.current: “I admit it. You are supernatural powers incarnate.”
findings.defect: The established plural term “supernatural powers” cannot naturally function as the complement of “incarnate” in this construction.
findings.rationale: The source calls Jin Taekyung 괴력난신 itself; “the very embodiment of supernatural powers” preserves that identification while producing grammatical English.
findings.replacement: “I admit it. You are the very embodiment of supernatural powers.”

findings.current: Was this not supernatural powers? Was this not a miracle?
findings.defect: “Was this not supernatural powers?” is ungrammatical because the plural abstract term cannot serve as this singular predicate.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the recovery as both 괴력난신 and a miracle; the replacement preserves both descriptions in natural English.
findings.replacement: Was this not the very manifestation of supernatural powers—a miracle?

findings.current: But once the enormous internal energy the Heavenly Power Demon had transferred to me was added, everything changed.
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicitly named technique through which the internal energy was transferred, losing part of the mechanical explanation and an established term.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly states that the transfer occurred through 격체전공, whose binding rendering is “Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body.”
findings.replacement: But the enormous internal energy the Heavenly Power Demon had given me through Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body changed everything.
findings.source: 그러나 천력마가 격체전공(隔體傳功)을 통해 넘겨준 막대한 공력이 더해지니 이야기가 달라졌다.

findings.defect: The draft reverses the subject of the unfinished threat: Taekyung is saying that he will do something to his opponent, not that his opponent will make him do something.
findings.rationale: 넌 내가 꼭 begins a first-person threat directed at “you” and leads into “I’m going to circumcise that mouth of yours.” The current line reverses that relationship and leaves the punchline grammatically disconnected.

findings.current: The moment I saw the ring on the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s finger, the first thing that came to mind was the Green Jade Buddha Staff, the sacred treasure of Shaolin Temple that the Blood Lord had stolen during the Shaolin bloodshed.
findings.defect: “During the Shaolin bloodshed” is an unnatural event label and sounds like a literal dictionary gloss.
findings.rationale: 소림 혈사 refers to the bloody massacre at Shaolin; “the massacre at Shaolin” conveys that event naturally without changing its meaning.
findings.replacement: The moment I saw the ring on the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s finger, the first thing that came to mind was the Green Jade Buddha Staff, the sacred treasure of Shaolin Temple that the Blood Lord had stolen during the massacre at Shaolin.
findings.source: 서천마군의 손가락에 끼워진 만독지환을 본 순간 처음으로 떠오른 것은 소림 혈사 당시 혈주가 탈취해 간 소림사의 신물, 녹옥불장(綠玉佛杖)이었다.

findings.current: The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes widened as the Myriad-Poison Ring vanished without a trace, as though erased by a rubber.
findings.defect: The draft omits the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s hostile, interrupted exclamation when the ring disappears, losing a pragmatic cue in his shift from shock to rage.
findings.rationale: The source gives him a direct, unfinished outburst immediately after the disappearance. It should remain, and “eraser” is the natural US English term for 지우개.
findings.replacement:
The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes widened as the Myriad-Poison Ring vanished without a trace, as though erased by an eraser.

“You…!”

findings.current: His heart had been shaken, so naturally his sword had been shaken as well.
findings.defect: The draft turns Taekyung’s causal tactical prediction into an awkward statement that both the opponent’s literal heart and sword have already been shaken.
findings.rationale: 마음 refers to the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s mental composure, while 흔들리기 마련 expresses the expected consequence that his sword or swordsmanship will consequently waver.
findings.replacement: With his composure shaken, his sword was bound to waver as well.
findings.source: 마음이 흔들렸으니 검 또한 흔들리기 마련.

summary: The draft contains one subject reversal that breaks a punchline, omits a named transfer technique and a hostile reaction, and weakens a tactical causal explanation. Several localized phrases also need grammatical or idiomatic correction.
